qwen-blank.gguf.label: qwen-blank
qwen-blank.gguf.notes: Example blank interrogation profile. Symlink this profile to a real GGUF when you want the proxy to forward no top-level instructions at all.

prompt-compiler.gguf.label: prompt-compiler
prompt-compiler.gguf.notes: Example v2 compiler profile. Create var/models/prompt-compiler.gguf as a symlink to a real GGUF in var/models/; routing uses the symlink target, while Codex sees prompt-compiler.

roleplay-character.gguf.label: roleplay-character
roleplay-character.gguf.notes: Example private-character profile shape. Keep private prompts under config/user or var; this only documents the generic harness knobs.

caveman.gguf.label: caveman
caveman.gguf.notes: Example compact Codex profile. Create var/models/caveman.gguf as a symlink to a real GGUF; routing uses the symlink target while Codex sees caveman. For behavior-only testing, point the symlink at the same backend GGUF already used by the normal profile; a different target intentionally triggers a backend swap.
